ambiguity.description: The applicable compensation rate and number of covered staff needed for the salary and wages support sheets remain unresolved.

patches.decision_note: The source asks for rates and covered staffing but does not yet establish uncertainty between the weekly schedule and an actual-session total.

value_updates.salary_adjustment_policy: Preserve the wage calculation based on the corrected service period and existing rates and hours rather than inflating wage inputs solely to match the full budget.

patches.decision_note: The wage Event should retain only the decision not to inflate wage inputs; selection of approved non-personnel categories is an independent budget-allocation behavior.
The message establishes only the FCC/FH identity and does not support propagation to the 154Q context.

replacement.title: Weeks Served Accuracy
replacement.definition: Record the correct number of weeks served in Annex B independently of the agreement date ranges and resulting wage calculations.

patches.decision_note: The weeks-served field has its own explicit correction and downstream effects, making it independently testable from service dates and wage calculations.

replacement.title: Approved Non-Personnel Budget Allocation
replacement.definition: Reconcile budget amounts remaining after salary calculations using only client-approved non-personnel categories, such as travel and consumable supplies.

patches.decision_note: Choosing approved non-personnel categories is independently constrained and can change without changing the underlying session-based wage calculation.
